name: Parvicursor
sum: Very small alvarezsaurid from the Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia with long slender legs for fast running.
holotype: PIN 4487/25, mostly vertebrae, pelvis and right hind limb, Khulsan, Barun Goyot Formation, Mongolia.
material: Only the holotype, which a 2022 study concluded was a juvenile.
biology: Long, slender legs adapted for fast running.
author: Karhu and Rautian 1996

sources.text: A. A. Karhu and A. S. Rautian. 1996. A new family of Maniraptora (Dinosauria: Saurischia) from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia. Paleontological Journal 30(5):583-592
